caption: Woudagemaal, Lemmer
composition: Brick pumping halls and a separate chimney on the dike · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the IJsselmeer dike the Woudagemaal shows long red-brick halls with tiled gables and a separate tall brick chimney. The lake is dark in front. The sky is partly cloudy, about 11.4°C, with wind near 2.5 km/h and cloud cover about 63%. The interior is closed. It is a steam pumping station, not a windmill.
